description: Plant grafting, air layering or cloning, is the gardening technique of replicating your favourite growing by creating new roots from which to grow another. If you fancy adding a new rose bush or fruit tree to your crop for example, these plant grafting balls can help speed things along. Simply select the plant or tree you wish to clone and identify a branch to use for the purpose.
